description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to amend the Gaz.Ex. No. 2113/09 which mentioned Excise Duty on Motor Vehicle
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification amending excise duty regulations under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act. It contains an order by the Minister of Finance modifying specific provisions in a previous gazette notification, which falls under legal amendments and regulatory frameworks (Type 5). While it mentions a minister by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail (only his title "Minister of Finance") and the primary purpose is regulatory amendment rather than personnel or structural government changes.
